bridge.source: MiaoTarot site/src/platform/xiaohongshu.ts and minitoolStorage.ts; MiaoTI minitool/bridge.js
bridge.modifications: 2026-11-03: ES2017 strict response checks, dedicated piano take storage, limited image actions, safe-area version checks

audioAdapter.source: Miao Beat historical 2026-11-02 local-piano-buffer probe; public/audio.js and public/sampled-audio.js
audioAdapter.modifications: 2026-11-03: eight white keys, same calibration and bounded voices, scheduled playback; master-only base without synth fallback
audioAdapter.velocityFormula: smplr1.1.0 midiVelToGain only; full MIT notice included at build

artwork: Existing approved complete orange-cat piano images scaled proportionally; every displayed frame includes complete cat, paws and instrument. AI-assisted images; no Bongo Cat artwork or detached limbs copied.
scores: Existing independent short melody transcriptions of Twinkle Twinkle Little Star and Ode to Joy; no third-party recordings or commercial full scores bundled.
runtimeBoundary: Native APIs and persistent storage vary by client. No direct network, external links, file download, microphone or system fullscreen. Picture cards contain no sound.
